identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H3. Tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, inputs, and UI text.

mono.usage: Use for hashtags, code snippets, and data values.

primary.description: Acid Lime - Use for primary CTAs and key accents only.

secondary.description: Electric Violet - Use for secondary actions and depth.

borders.neon_trace: Use a moving gradient border for high-value cards.

visual_enhancers.texture: Add a subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.03) to the main background to kill digital flatness.

spacing.base: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. p-8, p-12.
spacing.container_padding: p-6 or p-8 for bordered containers.

grid_system.marketing: Mode A: Tetris Grid. Asymmetric cols-12. Mix Hero (col-span-8), Square (col-span-4), Tall (row-span-2).
grid_system.dashboard: Mode B: Control Room. Dense grid-cols-4. Gap-4. Every pixel utilized.

alignment.general: Left align text. Center only for specific hero moments.

buttons.primary: bg-[#CCFF00] text-black hover:bg-[#B3E600] rounded-full font-bold px-8 py-6 transition-transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 text-white border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 rounded-full px-6 py-6

cards.style: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden relative group

inputs.style: bg-black/50 border-white/10 focus:border-[#CCFF00] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#CCFF00] rounded-xl h-12

navigation.sidebar: Fixed left, glassmorphism, collapsed on mobile.

hero.description: Young woman holding smartphone on gimbal - Hero Image
Male blogger recording video - Alternate Hero

backgrounds.description: Abstract neon lines digital landscape - Section Background
Multicolored neon abstract - Feature Card Background

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 for normal text. Use APCA standards.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings (color: #CCFF00) for keyboard navigation.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements (z-index).
NEVER use AI assistant emojis (🤖, 🧠) as icons.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-energy, dark-mode social media tool. Use the 'Acid Lime' (#CCFF00) as your primary action color to cut through the dark UI. Implement the 'Bento Grid' layout for the dashboard. Use Shadcn components but override their styles to match the 'Cyber-Acid' aesthetic defined in colors.palette. Ensure the app feels fast and 'viral'.
